data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Hello! First, confirm the user's email address is correct and active in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. Advise the user to check their spam/junk folders. If still not found, ask them to whitelist 'no-reply@cloudesk.com'. As a last resort, an Admin can force a password reset for them via 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users > [User] > Reset Password'. [T-38] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
